name: 29445 · Goose Creek, SC
findings: ZIP 29445 (Goose Creek) has 114 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29445 (Goose Creek) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 29445 (Goose Creek) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 51% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 69 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
